title: Maximum Subarray Sum
statement:
Find the largest sum obtainable from any contiguous run of elements.

## Your function

```
int max_subarray_sum(const int *values, int count);
```

## Rules

- The run must be contiguous and must contain at least one element,
  unless the array is empty.
- For an empty array, return `0`.
- If every value is negative, the answer is the single largest value --
  not `0`, because you have to pick at least one element.

## Watch out

The obvious approach checks every start and end point, which is
O(n squared). There is a single-pass O(n) solution: walk the array
keeping the best sum ending at the current element, and the best sum
seen anywhere.
